text:
mia: Quick question — I have a 30–40 minute lunch window, want something uplifting or funny. Any short films or single-episode recs? :sandwich:

sam: Nice! If you want a proper short-film vibe, watch a Pixar short + another 15–20m short. 'Paperman' (6m) + 'Partly Cloudy' (6m) + a tea break = perfect. :popcorn:

jordan: If you're into single eps: try 'Atlanta' S1E1 (~33m) or 'Fleabag' ep 1 (~25m) — both bite-sized and satisfying.

anika: For a feel-good doc that's ~40m, check 'The Queen of Basketball' — very uplifting and a good lunch watch.

ben: Quick list to pick from: 'Paperman' (6m), 'Bao' (8m), 'The Lunch Date' (short), 'The Queen of Basketball' (~40m), 'Black Mirror' *some* episodes are ~60m so avoid those, but 'Nosedive' is 63m — too long. For comedy sitcoms: 'The IT Crowd' S1E1 (24m), 'Broad City' eps are 20–25m.

luis: If you want weird/arty: 'World of Tomorrow' (16m) or 'La Jetée' (28m) — both short and stick with you.

mia: Love this, thanks. Any streaming tips? Company wifi can be picky about Hulu/paid stuff.

sam: I think 'Queen of Basketball' was on Netflix/ESPN docs last I checked. For shorts, YouTube or Vimeo is safest. Also here's a tiny FFmpeg trick if you have a longer file and just want a 40m clip:

```
ffmpeg -ss 00:00:00 -t 00:40:00 -i movie.mp4 -c copy lunch_clip.mp4
```

anika: haha very practical. Also, if you want a 30m playlist: Pixar short (5–8m) + 'World of Tomorrow' (16m) + 6–8m music video = ~30.

ben: If anyone's collecting these, I'll drop a quick Google Sheet with streaming/source links. Want me to add these picks? :white_check_mark:

mia: Please! Share it here and I'll add a few more (esp. animated shorts).

luis: Also, for nostalgia/comfort, 'The Muppet Show' clips are 20–30m compilations on YouTube. 

jordan: Endorsing 'World of Tomorrow' and 'Bao' — both great lunch-time brain candy.

ben: sheet: https://drive.company/recs/lunch-flicks (internal link) :link:

mia: Thanks all — perfect ideas for tomorrow's lunch watch. :thumbsup:
